specs.prompt: Use case: background-extraction / stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated painted paper poster for the Aleria Gwynthor notice board. The first reference is the user's EXISTING composed Gwynthor board and defines the exact requested poster design. The other reference is an existing standalone poster and defines the EXACT matching drawing style. Recreate just the specified poster from the first reference as a separate clean PNG asset. Faithfully preserve the existing simple dark-brown ink outlines, warm ochre old paper, gently uneven hand-drawn frame and flat muted coloring. Keep the very simple cartoon ink lettering and wavy filler writing marks. This is a faithful reconstruction of a missing existing asset, not a visual redesign. All paper inside the silhouette must be opaque. True transparent alpha outside the sheet silhouette, including through torn-out gaps. No background, no board, no wall, no people, no hands, no table. No metal nail, no pin, no fastener; nails will be added independently in the application. No outside shadow, glow, halo, watermark, artificial checkerboard. Show the entire poster straight-on, upright and unrotated with comfortable transparent margin, no cropped edges. Subject: the wide horizontal wedding announcement at the TOP CENTER-RIGHT of reference 1, immediately below the big ANZEIGE TAFEL sign, to the right of the ANKUNDIGUNG beer-mug poster. Reconstruct that ONE landscape rectangular paper only. Approximately 1.63:1 width-to-height silhouette. Double-line hand-drawn dark-brown border, simple rose-and-leaf ornaments at left and right upper edges, a pair of plain interlocked wedding rings near the top right. Large bold dark-brown serif headline EXACTLY "HOCHZEIT!!". Below it a narrow hand-drawn framed strip reads EXACTLY "Tudwal Draig & Revelyn Penderyn". Below that 7-8 simple wavy dark-brown lines representing text. Simple warm ochre paper, subtle painted grain. No other real text, no extra symbols. Output square transparent canvas containing only this landscape poster.
